plugins.name: hackmd
plugins.description: Connect Claude to HackMD via OAuth MCP — create and edit notes, organize folders and books, push content, and visualize trade-offs. Requires HackMD account; no API token setup.

skills.name: hackmd-mcp-usage
skills.description:
Cross-tool policy for HackMD MCP tools (https://mcp.hackmd.io/, OAuth — no API
token). Diff-before-patch when calling update-note or update-team-note
(hook-enforced baseline). Structure-first when organizing notes into folders or
books. Search honesty when locating notes (search-notes is title-only).
Audience discipline and capability-gap disclosure when sharing or when MCP
lacks the needed action. Metadata discipline when creating or retitling notes.
skills.description_zh: 提供 HackMD OAuth MCP 的跨工具规则：修改前比较差异、整理目录书籍先保结构、明确搜索仅匹配标题、共享时限定受众并披露能力缺口，以及创建改名的元数据规范。

skills.name: push-to-hackmd
skills.description: Publish to HackMD via OAuth MCP. Use when the user says "push to HackMD" or "publish to HackMD" (create a note), "save to HackMD" or "backup to HackMD" (upload content), or "update this HackMD note" (merge without clobbering). Route "visualize" or audience one-page requests to visualize-hmd.
skills.description_zh: 通过 OAuth MCP 在 HackMD 新建发布笔记、保存备份内容或合并更新已有笔记而不覆盖，讨论可视化交由 visualize-hmd。

skills.name: visualize-hmd
skills.description: Crux-first HTML/CSS visualization of the current discussion, published as a HackMD note via OAuth MCP. Use when the user asks to visualize or turn the discussion into a webpage, wants a single shareable page that explains the discussion to an audience, or asks to update an existing visualization note. Not for uploading existing files — route those to push-to-hackmd.
skills.description_zh: 将当前讨论按核心要点制作 HTML/CSS 可视化，并通过 OAuth MCP 发布或更新 HackMD 单页笔记，便于向受众分享；已有文件上传交由 push-to-hackmd。
